newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Monday after making early gains but buying interest was limited, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,410-15 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,405 rupiah.
"The market was quiet in the second session because of the declines in Malaysia," one trader said. "But I don't think olein prices will weaken because of the high crude palm oil prices."
Traders also attributed the morning rise in olein prices to a statement by state logistics agency BULOG chief Beddu Amang last Friday that olein prices should not exceed 1,500 rupiah.
Amang told reporters that if olein prices dipped below 1,400 rupiah/kg, exporters and producers would complain.
Traders said Amang's remarks seem to give the impression that BULOG would not intervene in the market until prices touched 1,500 rupiah.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Antea will leave the North Sumatran port on Wednesday for Kuala Enok, Batam with 25,000 tonnes of crude palm oil. Traders said the consignment could eventually be bound for Europe.
